title: Reasoning-effort study (Findings 4.8)
description: 24 games of claude-opus-5-5 at low, medium and high effort as players 1, 2 and 3 (labelled claude-opus-5-5, #2 and #3). Cycle seating over seeds 895–918, no experiment profile. The 24 games were fixed in advance and run in batches of 6. Game 15 was re-judged after the output cap was raised to 128k. Wins: high 12, medium 7, low 5.
